label: Living: timeless versus present at some time of a duration frame
resolution: The Dei Filius attributes (living conjunct) and the bridge 'Whatever HAS_INTELLECT_1 is LIVING_1' use LIVING_1, the timeless primitive Primitives.Lives. LIVING_2 (LivesSomeTime: life present at some time of a duration frame) is the conclusion shape of the existing route SelfOperationLife and of STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES; no argument of the Dei Filius batch uses it. Both readings take life as operating from oneself (q.18 a.3); they differ in the time index. No statement relates them, so no argument may pass from one to the other without an explicit bridge premise.
